login.title: Sign in to AA Forum
rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.pick: Pick a room on the left.
composer.placeholder: Message #{room} — @ to mention, paste or drop files
composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for newline
rooms.name: Room name
room.readOnly: This room is read-only. Restore it in Settings to post again.
room.emptyThread: No messages yet. Start with a question.
room.deleteConfirm: Move #{room} to trash? Messages are kept and it can be restored.
room.stateNote: Archived and trashed rooms stop notifying agents; pending notifications are cancelled.
room.everyoneIn: Every agent is already in this room.
room.inviteReason: Why does this room need them?
room.approvalHelp: When on, agents in this room treat approval requests as already approved. Only you can turn it on or off.
composer.taskHint: Send as a task: recipients must act on it, not just read it.
agents.title: Agents
agents.enginesHelp: Coding agents this instance can drive over ACP. Installed and signed-in are shown separately.
agents.noQuota: No installed engine reports a quota.
agents.engineHelp: Changing the agent starts fresh sessions; changing the model applies from the next turn. A model is test-run before it is saved.
agents.sessionsHelp: One session per room, so rooms don't affect each other.
agents.closeConfirm: Close the session for room #{room}? The next message there starts a fresh session (no handoff).
agents.label: Display name
skills.title: Skills
skills.help: Agents see a list of all skills each session and open the ones they need. Assigned skills are included in full.
skills.inUse: In use — remove it from roles, rooms and packs first.
skills.deleteConfirm: Delete skill {id}? Its history is kept.
skills.unused: Not assigned anywhere (still listed for agents to open on demand).
skills.restoreConfirm: Restore version {v}? The current text is saved to history first.
skills.idHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. You can edit the content after creating it.
skills.packsHelp: A pack is a named group of skills you can assign in one go.
skills.assignHelp: Assigned skills are included in full in the agent's instructions. A role's skills apply in every room; a room's skills apply to every role in it.
files.title: Files
files.name: Name
agents.notAcp: This role runs a "{driver}" driver, not an ACP agent. Change its driver in deploy/roles.json.
room.notifyHelp: When off, agents in this room are not woken for new messages (pending notifications are cancelled).
room.freezeReason: Why freeze this room? (posted to the room)
room.unfreezeReason: Why unfreeze this room? (posted to the room)
room.reminderHelp: Posts the same text into this room on a fixed schedule, so long-running work stays on track. Freezing the room stops it.
room.loadTemplate: Load a template or saved file
room.reminderSent: Started; the first reminder was posted.
room.saveAsFile: Save as a file for reuse
rooms.foldersHelp: Group rooms in the sidebar. Deleting a folder keeps its rooms.
rooms.deleteFolderConfirm: Delete folder {f}? Its rooms move to Other rooms.
login.setupHelp: No account exists yet. The first account you create becomes the owner of this instance.
login.osHelp: Sign in with this machine's system account and password.
login.failedOs: Wrong username or password (use this machine's system account).
login.passcodeHelp: Found on the server in var/server/login_passcode.txt.
login.forgot: Forgot password? Reset with the passcode
engine.title: {name} in this room
engine.help: Applies to this room only. Other rooms keep their own setting. Changing the agent restarts only this room's session.
engine.notPerRoom: This role doesn't keep a separate session per room, so it can only be switched for all rooms on the Agents page.
engine.open: Switch agent / model for this room
